enabled.description: Enable or disable the OLPC keyboard support daemon.

keyboard_device.description: Input device node for the OLPC XO keyboard (e.g., /dev/input/event0 or a symlink).

modifier_keys.description: List of modifier keys to remap or special-handle (e.g., Alt, Super, Control).

pidfile.description: Path to the file where the daemon writes its process ID.

keymaps.description: Custom keymap overrides: a list of key remappings. Each item maps a source key to a destination key.

enable_fn_handling.description: Enable special handling of Fn key combinations (e.g., volume up/down, screen brightness).

legacy_backlight.description: Use legacy sysfs backlight interface (required only for XO-1 and XO-1.5 with older kernels).
